A further 60 `sorry` sit in tracked `scratch_*`/`ScratchPicC` dead-lane files that no build elaborates (inbox `I-1606`) |

48	## Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild  *(from-scratch rebuild — prover stage, 16 open `sorry` in 2 of 824 library modules)* ✨
49	
50	**Goal:** the EXTENDED challenge (core eight + `Jacobian.functor` + field base change with
51	cocycle coherence), rebuilt clean/general/mathlib-idiomatic per the `rebuild` task charter.
52	Route fixed in `informal/route-decision.md`: `J := Pic⁰` via the étale-sheafified Picard
53	functor (curve-specialized Kleiman, no Quot schemes), Albanese via Milne III.6.1,
54	`genus := dim_k H¹(C,𝒪_C)`.
55	
56	- [x] **Wave 1 — curve substrate + genus lane, COMPLETE** ✨ *(2026-07-11)* — smooth ⇒
57	  geometrically reduced/integral; `Γ(C,𝒪_C) ≅ k`; ℙ¹ + Laurent charts; **finite `π : C → ℙ¹`**
58	  (`exists_isFinite_toP1`, via a new unramified-over-Dedekind brick, RationalMap spreading-out,
59	  topological quasi-finiteness + ZMT); `ModuleCat k` sheaf cohomology with affine `H¹'` vanishing;
60	  Mayer–Vietoris (0,1)-slice + two-cover `H1Cok` bridge (no affine-intersection hypothesis!);
61	  two-lattice ladder ⇒ **`Module.Finite k H¹(C,𝒪_C)`** — `genus` defined AND correct, axiom-clean.
62	- [x] **Wave 2 — rigidity (2a) and the χ-ledger / RR-lite (2b)** ✨ — Mumford Form-I rigidity +
63	  Milne I 1.2 (a pointed morphism of group schemes is a homomorphism), hypotheses weaker than
64	  Milne's; Euler-characteristic ledger complete.
65	- [x] **Wave 3 — relative Picard functor** ✨ — cocycle `Ȟ¹(𝒪ˣ)` carrier, étale-plus construction.

67	  is the authoritative breakdown — the gate is the DD-R certificate lane. Settled 2026-07-25:

86	## Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge  *(core engine — prover stage, 31 open `sorry` in 13 of 374 modules)*
87	
88	**Goal:** construct the Jacobian of a smooth proper geometrically integral curve as
89	`Pic^0`, prove that it is an abelian variety of dimension equal to the genus, and
90	establish the Albanese universal property. The structured roadmap command
91	`horizon roadmap list --focus AJC.jacobian` is the authoritative work breakdown.
92	
93	*Re-measured 2026-07-31 (comment-stripped, `scratch*`/`probe*` excluded): 361 of 374 counted
94	paths are sorry-free, with all 31 remaining `sorry`s in 13 — the largest groups
95	`Albanese/AlbaneseUP` (6), `Jacobian` (4), `Cohomology/CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional` (3),
96	`Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety` (3). Both halves of this ratio drift hourly under parallel lanes.
97	Re-derive with
98	`lake build AlgebraicJacobian 2>&1 | grep 'declaration uses' | sort -u`
99	rather than quoting these.*

103	    its sections, basic opens, over-equivalences, module-cover conservativity).
104	  - [x] Relative Spec, projective morphisms, section rings; gluing, Zariski and

153	  `Scheme.Pic0Scheme` — so what remains is mathematics, not assembly. **Decided 2026-07-28 by
154	  binding human decision `I-0491`:** the headline is stated over an arbitrary field with no
155	  rational-point binder, via the étale-sheafified Picard functor. `hasRationalPoint_of_curve` was
156	  false as stated and is deleted, not proved; it survives only as the theorem
157	  `hasRationalPoint_of_curve_of_isAlgClosed` over an algebraically closed field. Five obligations
158	  remain, and the witness carries `sorryAx` until all five land: étale representability
159	  (`fgaPicardRepresentability`), `Pic0Et.geometricallyReduced`, `Pic0Et.universallyClosed`,

186	complex computes `Rⁱf_* F`. Unconditional (no enough-injectives appeal).

# A pre-commit guard installed into every out-of-tree git. Two protections:
#
# 1. Secrets: an accidental credential (in a transcript, config, or dropped
#    file) is REDACTED to XXXX in the staged content and warned about — it never
#    blocks the commit. High-confidence, case-sensitive, key-prefixed formats
#    only, so ordinary content (long camelCase identifiers, lowercase base64) is
#    not touched. The redaction is best-effort and fails open: any error just
#    warns and lets the commit through, so a guard bug can never break commits.
#    Rotate any real credential regardless. ARCHON_HORIZON_ALLOW_SECRETS=1 skips
#    the scan entirely.
#
# 2. Silent clobbers on the shared ledger: a commit whose index was seeded
#    from a STALE HEAD (a concurrent session committed since the read-tree)
#    produces a tree that simply lacks the other session's new files — git
#    commits it without any error and the files are deleted. Likewise a plain
#    commit through a polluted shared index sweeps in thousands of staged
#    deletions. Both present the same way at commit time: staged deletions the
#    committer never asked for. The guard:
#      - if ARCHON_COMMIT_BASE is set (Archon's own integration commits set it
#        to the sha the private index was seeded from), require it to still be
#        HEAD — a cheap compare-and-swap; the caller re-seeds and retries;
#      - otherwise (an agent's plain git) reject any commit that stages
#        deletions, unless ARCHON_HORIZON_ALLOW_DELETIONS=1 says they are
#        intentional. New/modified files are always fine.
_SECRET_HOOK = r"""#!/bin/sh
# Auto-installed by Archon Horizon. Redacts obvious secrets (never blocks) and
# blocks only silent clobbers of the shared ledger.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Is every blueprint `\leanok` honest?  Run from the project root:
#
#   scripts/leanok-audit.sh
#

# nothing at the mark says so.  So the marks have to be joined against the axioms of
# the declarations they pin.  Reading cannot answer this question; that is the whole
# reason this script exists.
#
# Two positions, two different claims, measured SEPARATELY:
#
#   * a PROOF-level mark says the proof is formalised.  One on a `sorryAx` carrier is
#     a DEFECT.  Expected count: 0.
#   * a STATEMENT-level mark says the signature is formalised, which is TRUE of a
#     `sorry`-bodied declaration.  One on a `sorryAx` carrier is LEGITIMATE and must
#     NOT be "fixed".  Expected count: 34 and growing, as the open chapters take
#     landings.

# is asserted per position, in code, and the script fails on a shortfall.  Six
# separate domain-shrinking bugs have been found in this audit, each of which printed
# a plausible `0 defects` line while examining a strict subset:
#
#   1. `#print axioms` on an absent name is an error and `lean` halts at 100 of them,
#      truncating the audit silently.  (Gone: `collectAxioms` returns a value.)
#   2. an output log matched by its own input glob and re-ingested as a batch.
#   3. a parser anchored on the closing quote of `'<name>'`, dropping every name
#      containing an apostrophe -- 49 pins do.
#   4. `#print axioms` printing `does not depend on any axioms`, a DIFFERENT sentence
#      that a `depends on axioms: [...]` regex never matches.
#   5. `split` numbering past `az` to `ba`, so a `lk_a*` glob skipped 33 pins.
#   6. `re.search` keeping only the FIRST `\lean{}` macro of a statement; two nodes in
